notes: Host now declares CALL_PHONE, READ_CONTACTS, READ_CALL_LOG, SEND_SMS and READ_SMS so the new PHONE and SMS modules can ask for them at runtime. New modules: PHONE (car-style dialer, contacts, call history), SMS (car-style inbox, threads, composer) and BROWSER (WebView with a top 40% developer panel for console, network timings, JavaScript evaluation and page info).
